name: Ghent car park occupancy (Mobiliteitsbedrijf Gent)
short: Live free spaces in Ghent's public car parks. Free, no key, Flemish free-reuse licence.
summary: The City of Ghent's open data portal publishes real-time occupancy of its public car park garages as a keyless Opendatasoft API. Each record gives name, total capacity, available capacity, occupation percent, open-now and temporarily-closed flags, an occupancy trend, opening hours, operator and coordinates. On 2026-11-08 the dataset held 15 car parks, each stamped within minutes of the call (for example Sint-Michiels 316 of 450 free).

tasks: free spaces and occupancy percent for a Ghent car park now
list Ghent car parks with capacity, coordinates and opening hours
whether a Ghent car park is open or temporarily closed

coverage.notes: 15 public car parks managed under Mobiliteitsbedrijf Gent as listed on 2026-11-08; not on-street parking.

licensing.summary: City of Ghent (Mobiliteitsbedrijf Gent) publishes this dataset under the Flemish 'Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik' (model licence for free reuse, v1.0). The licence text says the licensee must name the licensor and, where possible, the year or date the product was made available, and must not suggest official status or endorsement. The product is supplied as is, with no guarantee of fitness. AI training and resale are not specifically addressed.
